checks.title: App confinement (AppArmor or SELinux)
checks.detail: Neither AppArmor nor SELinux is active, so an exploited app can reach everything you can. Active security modules: landlock,lockdown,yama,integrity,bpf.
checks.fix: Install apparmor, add lsm=landlock,lockdown,yama,integrity,apparmor,bpf to the kernel command line, enable apparmor.service, then reboot.

checks.title: Secure Boot
checks.detail: Off: a tampered bootloader or kernel would still start.
checks.fix: Sign your boot files (sbctl) and turn Secure Boot on in the firmware.

checks.title: Kernel lockdown
checks.detail: Off: root can still change the running kernel (modules unsigned, /dev/mem).
checks.fix: lockdown=integrity on the kernel command line (needs signed modules, Secure Boot).

checks.title: CPU flaw mitigations
checks.detail: All 1 known CPU flaws are mitigated or n/a.

checks.title: Audit log (auditd)
checks.detail: auditd isn't running, so there's no tamper-evident record of logins and privilege use.

checks.title: USB device control (USBGuard)
checks.detail: Any USB device is trusted as soon as it's plugged in (e.g. a fake keyboard).
checks.fix: Install usbguard, generate a policy from your devices, enable usbguard.service.

checks.title: Kernel pointers hidden
checks.detail: kernel.kptr_restrict = 0. Hides kernel addresses from users, which exploits use to find their target.

checks.title: Kernel log restricted
checks.detail: kernel.dmesg_restrict = 1. Only admins can read the kernel log, which can leak addresses.

checks.title: Process snooping limited
checks.detail: kernel.yama.ptrace_scope = 1. A program can only debug its own children, so malware can't read other apps' memory.

checks.title: Unprivileged BPF off
checks.detail: kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled = 1. Stops users loading BPF programs, a common kernel exploit path.

checks.title: BPF JIT hardened
checks.detail: net.core.bpf_jit_harden = 2. Blinds constants in JIT-compiled BPF against JIT spraying.

checks.title: Full memory randomisation
checks.detail: kernel.randomize_va_space = 2. ASLR for stack, libraries and heap.

checks.title: Kernel replacement blocked
checks.detail: kernel.kexec_load_disabled = 1. Stops a root exploit from loading a new kernel without a reboot.

checks.title: Symlink attacks blocked
checks.detail: fs.protected_symlinks = 1. Stops tricks with links in shared folders like /tmp.

checks.title: Hardlink attacks blocked
checks.detail: fs.protected_hardlinks = 1. Users can't hardlink files they don't own.

checks.title: FIFO attacks blocked
checks.detail: fs.protected_fifos = 1. Limits opening other users' pipes in shared folders.

checks.title: Shared-folder file attacks blocked
checks.detail: fs.protected_regular = 0. Limits opening other users' files in shared folders.

checks.title: No core dumps from setuid programs
checks.detail: fs.suid_dumpable = 0. Crashing a privileged program can't leak its memory to a file.

checks.title: SYN flood protection
checks.detail: net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 1. Keeps the network stack up under a SYN flood.

checks.title: Spoofed packets dropped
checks.detail: net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter = 1. Drops packets whose source address can't be routed back.

checks.title: ICMP redirects ignored
checks.detail: net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0. Other machines can't reroute this one's traffic.

checks.title: IPv6 redirects ignored
checks.detail: net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0. Same as above, for IPv6.
